item.title: Shell and Exxon Cancel North Sea Gas Asset Sale to Viaro Energy | OilPrice.com
item.description: ExxonMobil and Shell have canceled the planned sale of their joint UK Southern North Sea gas assets, including the critical Bacton gas terminal, to Viaro Energy after completion conditions were not met and the deal faced lengthy regulatory review.

item.title: Trump Tells Iranian Protesters “Help Is on the Way” as Death Toll Mounts | OilPrice.com
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump has escalated his response to Iran’s deadly crackdown on nationwide protests, warning of strong action, urging demonstrators to persist, and fueling international condemnation of Tehran’s actions.

item.title: How Greenland Became the Most Dangerous Real Estate on Earth | OilPrice.com
item.description: Negotiations over the US demand for Greenland are testing the limits of the Atlantic alliance, forcing Europe to pay a "volatility tax" in the form of defense hikes and subsidized mining projects to preserve Danish sovereignty and the post-war security order.

item.title: China’s Imports of Venezuelan Oil Set to Crumble | OilPrice.com
item.description: A month-long US blockade of Venezuelan waters is expected to cause a significant drop in China's imports of Venezuelan crude and fuel oil in February, despite new efforts by Trafigura and Vitol to facilitate sales to Asian refiners.

item.title: EIA Shows Crude Oil Inventories Continue to Rise | OilPrice.com
item.description: Crude oil inventories in the United States increased by 3.4 million barrels during the week ending January 14, according to new data from the U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA) released on Wednesday

item.title: Citi Sees $70 Brent in Near Term as Geopolitical Risks Mount | OilPrice.com
item.description: Citi has raised its 0-3 month forecast for Brent Crude to $70 per barrel, citing increased geopolitical risks in the Middle East and supply disruption concerns in Iran and Russia.

item.title: Is Greenland’s Oil Really Worth It? | OilPrice.com
item.description: Independent estimates put unrisked recoverable resources in Greenland at ~4 billion barrels, with ~1.2 billion barrels targeted by the initial wells.

item.title: Kazakhstan Cut December Oil Output By 230 Kb/d | OilPrice.com
item.description: Kazakhstan cut oil production in December by more than 200 Kb/d, with output averaging 1.522 million barrels per day in the final month down from 1.759 mb/d in November

item.title: Azerbaijan and U.S. Weigh Cooperation on Peace Corridor and Energy Projects | OilPrice.com
item.description: A U.S. Trade and Development Agency delegation held exploratory talks in Azerbaijan on infrastructure, energy, and investment tied to a U.S.-brokered Armenia-Azerbaijan peace corridor, though no formal agreements were announced.

item.title: Enverus: Venezuela To Increase Oil Output 50% By 2035 | OilPrice.com
item.description: Industry consultant Enverus has predicted that Venezuela will increase oil production 50% and hit 1.5 million barrels a day by 2035 following the capture of long-time leader Nicolas Maduro by the Trump administration
